game_state_note: Game is in Year 3 Season 2 (Y3S2, 'Death Tides' era content through Y3S1 'Shattered Seas' + Y3S2). World Tiers 1-4 (Rogue Storms, Brutal Tempest). Ship upgrade cap Level 7 (Masterwork Kit). 'Year 2+' covers all mechanics below.

armor_mitigation.confidence_note: Two-step structure likely (single dev-quote source); exact armor curve unpublished — community has no agreed formula.
armor_mitigation.description: Armor rating reduces incoming base damage (step 1 of the two-step formula); per-type resistances (Explosive %, Flooding %, Fire %) reduce the special-damage portions (step 2). Example armor: Ouroboros (Epic, 1100 armor, 20% Explosive / 30% Flooding / 30% Fire resist). Armor can be modified in combat: Bedar ram -150 armor rating for 30s; Frigate 'Grit' +50 armor per stack (10 stacks); 'Armor Shredder' seasonal affix -150/200 armor in 150m radius; Junk 'Ember' -2% armor rating per stack; Daycurvage Station furniture +100 armor rating. Flat/% damage-taken modifiers: Black Prince 'Resolute' -50% damage taken below 33% hull; Heyden's Guard 'Ember Ward' -25% burning weapon damage (-50% while bracing); Volta's Ward -25% Stormstruck damage; Daycurvage Station -24% incoming secondary damage; Braced Gunwales -20% incoming secondary damage while anchored.
armor_mitigation.formula: damage_after_armor = f(base_damage, armor_rating) — exact function unpublished (estimated). resistance_step: type_portion * (1 - resistance_pct).

ascension.confidence_note: System structure confirmed by official patch notes and press; his exact roll values are user-observed.
ascension.description: Y2S1 (Apr 2025) introduced Item Ascension at the Blacksmith (requires Infamy Tier 9+, quest 'Ascension and Modification'). Three modification grades: Basic (general improvements), Advanced (noteworthy improvements), Special (powerful improvements with unique properties). Modification slots by weapon rarity: Common = 2 Basic + 1 Advanced + 1 Special; Uncommon = 1 Basic + 1 Advanced + 1 Special; Rare = 2 Basic + 1 Special; Epic = 1 Basic + 1 Advanced. Each slot costs Ascension Pieces to unlock (e.g. Common slots cost 2/3/5/5 pieces). Mods include flat damage (e.g. +damage/shot), % damage, reload, and new behaviors. Y3S1 added Mythic Ascension + Mythic Reforge: push gear beyond standard limits with Mythic Modifications farmed via Nightshade Pearls (World Tiers 3-4), e.g. 'Wildfire' (spread burning 300m on Ablaze) and 'Voltaic Charge' (bonus electric damage when target triggers Stormstruck). Y3S2 added Adept Modded Weapons + Mythic Exclusive Mods (Culverin/Demi-cannon/Long Gun/Ballista) and Modification Transfer (move mods between same-kind gear; costs Ascension Flux from salvaging ascended items; source item destroyed).
ascension.user_observed_example: His 4th-Ascension Infernal Maw (Springloader auxiliary): Basic tier +71 damage/shot (flat, applies to base damage in step 1); Advanced tier +33.1% existing burning damage (multiplies the burning portion); Mythic tier +7% electric damage (adds/multiplies electric portion). Treat flat tier as additive to base damage before % bonuses; % tiers as multiplicative with their damage type's pool. NOTE: official Y2S1 grade names are Basic/Advanced/Special — 'Mythic' as a tier name on his weapon reflects Y3 Mythic Ascension naming; exact behavior of his rolls validated from his screenshots, not from web sources.

base_damage_formula.confidence_note: Two-step structure from a single secondary source quoting devs (zleague); consistent with all perk wordings and armor/resistance itemization, but the exact armor math is unpublished.
base_damage_formula.description: Per a Ubisoft Singapore dev explanation quoted in community press: damage is a two-step calculation. Step 1: the weapon's base damage is reduced by the target's armor rating. Step 2: any 'special' damage dealt (piercing, burning/fire, electric, flooding, toxic, etc.) is then reduced by the target's specific resistance to that damage type. Weapon perks like 'Burning II: Adds 20% of damage as Burning Damage' compute the added portion as a fraction of the hit's damage, then that portion goes through the type-resistance step.
base_damage_formula.formula: final_hit = armor_step(base_damage * Π(1 + damage_bonus_i)) then for each special-type portion: portion * (1 - resistance_to_type). Exact armor-rating-to-reduction function is NOT published.

brace.confidence_note: Brace mechanics confirmed from many sources; the exact base % mitigation is unpublished (estimated).
brace.description: Brace is a manual block: reduces incoming damage while held, consuming crew stamina AND a Brace Strength pool. Pool examples: Junk base 17000 (425/s recovery), Snow L7 33000. Recovery scales with ship upgrades (L6 +12.5%, L7 +25% for non-Snow). Bracing synergies: Snow 'Tenacity' recovers 4% brace/s while bracing (+50% strength, +150% recovery); Hulk 'Ironclad' -20% brace depletion; Ouroboros 'Amalgamate' heals 15% of damage braced; Snow 'Vindictive' (Y2S2): after bracing damage, +20% weapon damage for 20s; Battle Junk 'Endure': -2% damage taken per braced attack, stacking to 20%, expires after 12s without bracing; Silver Sentinel 'Vigilance': -3000 flat damage for first 2s of brace, then -200 flat (shows flat-reduction components exist in the formula). Y1S3 dev note mentions a 'general decrease to damage mitigation' — base brace % was nerfed at some point.
brace.formula: damage_while_bracing = incoming_damage * (1 - brace_mitigation_pct) [- flat reductions from perks]. Base brace_mitigation_pct is NOT published.

crew_stamina_damage_effects.confidence_note: Absence of evidence across patch notes, guides, and item databases; the PvP-relevant stamina mechanic is brace denial.
crew_stamina_damage_effects.description: No confirmed direct link between crew stamina level and damage output found in any source. Stamina is consumed by trimming sails (cost reduced 60-80% in Y2S1.1 so it is 'primarily reserved for bracing') and by bracing; it is drained by enemy Toxic perks (La Piqure: 7 stamina per hit after Y2S1.1 nerf from 15 — dev note says a full salvo 'could take away most of a player's stamina... reducing their ability to brace, detrimental to tank builds'). Furniture modifies stamina economy (War Drums -50% trim cost in combat; Water Tank -50% brace cost +20% recovery; Sterile Galley +7% max; Rum Pantry +10% recovery; Tuning Station +10%/s out of combat). Indirect DPS effect only: zero stamina = cannot brace = must eat full damage / cannot tank. No '+damage while stamina full' style perk found.

dps_formula.confidence_note: Formula structure is standard and consistent with all published numbers; reload-stacking rule and status tick values are estimated.
dps_formula.description: Sustained DPS per weapon = (damage_per_shot * projectiles_per_volley * weakpoint_uptime_multiplier * status_DoT_contribution) / cycle_time, where cycle_time = time_to_fire_volley + reload_time_modified. Reload modifiers: multiple -% reload sources (e.g. Ram Rod -7% broadside, Leyden -6% electric, Mark of the Wolf +20% explosive fire rate, Snow Firebug -25% fire reload, Padewakang Siege -20% reload at half-sails). How multiple reload reductions combine (additive vs multiplicative) is NOT published — community calculators variously assume multiplicative; flag as estimated. Note 'fire rate +%' and 'reload -%' are tracked as separate stats in item text. Status DoT adds: Stormstruck 1000/3s + up to 4 arcs of 2000/3s; Ablaze DoT unquantified; Shell-shocked one-off 3000 AoE; Sambuk 5000 burning on Ablaze application. Example rebalances: Agni's Fury (Y3S2): 206 dmg/shot x 90 mag / 0.333s reload; Phoenix Talons: 18 hits per volley -> 1888 burning damage proc (200% vs Ablaze = 3776). Hit-chance/accuracy assumptions must be user inputs (no official accuracy model).
dps_formula.formula: dps = damage_per_shot * shots_per_volley * (1 / (fire_time + reload * Π(1 - reload_reduction_i))) * (1 + weakpoint_bonus * weakpoint_hit_rate) + status_dps. Reload stacking rule: estimated multiplicative; validate against gameplay.

furniture_modifiers.range_scaled_examples: User's loadout includes: '+5% rocket damage per 20% hull missing' (conditional % damage, user-observed); '+20% secondary damage up close scaling down 2% per 50m' (same family as Breechlock Furnace's official +30%/-3%/50m — validate exact numbers in-game); '+10% rocket secondary damage' (user-observed); 'dynamic ballast reducing secondary damage by range capped 30% at 600m+' (user-observed).
furniture_modifiers.secondary_damage_definition: Estimated: 'secondary damage' is a distinct damage category tracked separately from base weapon damage — likely the portion of damage contributed by weapon perk/status-added effects (the 'adds X% of damage as Y' portions) and/or proc damage. Furniture that boosts it multiplies that portion. Treat as a separate multiplicative pool in the calculator, flagged as estimated.
furniture_modifiers.stacking_rule: Community build guides (MMOexp-derived, e.g. u4gm, fifaah) state that furniture damage bonuses 'stack multiplicatively' (e.g. '+19% torpedo secondary damage... Stacks multiplicatively with the Tuning Station'). Official sources do NOT confirm additive vs multiplicative. Evidence that 'secondary damage' is a SEPARATE stat from 'weapon damage': Bilgefire Barrels (official Y2S1) lists '+10% Secondary Damage of Broadside weapons' AND '+5% Broadside weapons damage' as two distinct lines. Same pattern in Ram Rod Workshop (-7% reload / +7% secondary) and Copper Fashioning Station.

mastery.description: Seasonal Mastery tree (refreshed each season). Y3S2: up to 90 total Mastery Points (season levels + Seasonal Journey rewards); returning players get a head start (prior 60/70/80 -> start at 5/10/15); Tier 3 seasonal perk unlock at level 50. Y3S2 introduces the 'Impetus' combat resource: Relentless Force (Level 10 perk): 1 Impetus stack (max 10) per 8 weapon hits on enemies (demicannons need 4x = 32 hits); generating Impetus grants +15% Weapon Damage and +15% Repair Amount for 5s. Weakness Finder (Level 30): generating Impetus adds 20% chance to convert any weapon shot into a weakpoint hit for 5s. Firepower Order (Level 50): at 10 Impetus stacks, firing an Auxiliary weapon consumes all 10 and converts ALL weapon hits to weakpoint hits for 8s. Mastery loadouts: up to 10 saved node/perk allocations per ship. New Y3S2 Ship Details screen consolidates Ship + Weapons/Armor + Furniture + Mastery stats.
mastery.user_observed: 28 mastery points on his level 7 Frigate (user-observed; consistent with seasonal mastery system).

range_falloff.confidence_note: Demi-cannon 100m/120m bands and Siege Mortar no-drop-off confirmed officially; Breechlock scaling confirmed officially; exact intrinsic falloff curves per weapon family unpublished.
range_falloff.description: Confirmed: Demi-cannons (Y3S2 official) deal increased damage within 100m and damage falloff starts at 120m and beyond (exact curve unpublished). Siege Mortar is documented as dealing 'large amounts of crushing damage without drop-off' (launch-era), implying other weapon families DO have falloff. Breechlock Furnace (official Y2S1): secondary damage bonus scales with closeness: +30% up close, -3% per 50m of range (hits zero bonus at ~500m). Gimbal Ring Stores (pre-Y3S2): +17% demi damage beyond 180m for 12s. Kix Ball Station: +13% flooding damage from 200m for 10s. Alecto 'Draw': charging to max gives 300% damage and 900m range (range and damage scale with charge). User-observed furniture: '+20% secondary damage up close scaling down 2% per 50m' and 'dynamic ballast reducing secondary damage by range, capped 30% at 600m+' — same family as Breechlock's official text; validate exact numbers in-game.
range_falloff.formula: range_multiplier = 1 + max(0, close_bonus - falloff_per_50m * (range_m / 50)) for proximity-scaling furniture; weapon-intrinsic falloff curve unpublished (estimated).

status_effects.name: Ablaze
status_effects.stacking: Single instance per target; re-application refreshes. Spreads to nearby enemies via ship perks (Barge: 125m radius; Sambuk: 150m radius) and Mythic mods (Wildfire: 300m radius). Curable with repair kit.
status_effects.tick_formula: Described as 'high damage over a short period'. Exact per-tick numbers and duration NOT published. Sambuk ship perk deals a one-off 5000 burning damage when Ablaze is applied (separate from the DoT).
status_effects.trigger: Suffering significant fire/burning damage. Burning damage also increases Ablaze charge speed (Barge perk: +50%). Status charges per shot on a square meter before activating (not instant).

status_effects.name: Flooded
status_effects.stacking: Single instance; refreshes. Also slows the ship and decreases max hull health while active. Severe Damage portion must be restored by dedicated effects (Ouroboros 100/s, Barque/Cutter 0.4%/s, repair-weapon procs).
status_effects.tick_formula: 'Medium damage over a period of time.' Part of the damage is dealt as Severe Damage, which repair kits cannot restore (sources differ: 'half' per gamertweak vs 'damage from flooding is irreparable' per VideoGamer).
status_effects.trigger: Suffering significant flooding damage (flooding demi-cannons, torpedoes, rams with Lancer/Bullhorn perks).

status_effects.name: Torn Sails
status_effects.stacking: Diminishing returns apply (official Y2S1.1): after activation, target gains 45% charge resistance to Torn Sails for 45s; a second activation multiplies to ~70% total resistance and resets the 45s timer; one stack of resistance is removed per 45s without activation. Barge 'Devouring' perk (Y2S2) applies Torn Sails when hitting an Ablaze target. Charred targets receive +15% Torn Sails charge.
status_effects.tick_formula: Medium direct damage component; main effect is mobility: slows sailing speed by 75% (Y2S1.1 official).
status_effects.trigger: Tearing damage (tearing culverins, Scurlock's weapons). Deals medium damage and tears sails.

status_effects.name: Shell-shocked
status_effects.stacking: Diminishing returns apply (same 45%/70% charge-resistance rules as Torn Sails, official Y2S1.1). Damage dealt by the status can be increased (Breechlock Furnace +5%).
status_effects.tick_formula: Disables ALL of the target's weapons for 3.3s (nerfed from 5s in Y2S1.1) plus a one-off 3000 damage in an area on activation. +20% buildup threshold on player ships (Y2S1.1).
status_effects.trigger: Added Y2S1. Charges from shell-shock sources (e.g. Breechlock Furnace +7% charge rate; Mark of the Wolf: triggering Ablaze gives +100% shell-shocked charge rate for 10s).

status_effects.name: Stormstruck
status_effects.stacking: Single instance; refreshes on re-trigger. Arcs only if another hostile is within 150m.
status_effects.tick_formula: On activation, lasts 15s: target takes 1000 Electric damage every 3 seconds (5 ticks = 5000 total). Lightning arcs to up to 4 other hostiles within 150m every 3s, dealing 2000 damage per arc.
status_effects.trigger: Added Y1S3. Electric weapons charge it up with every shot; on full charge it activates.

status_effects.name: Taunt (Taunted)
status_effects.stacking: Charge-based like other statuses. Phoenix Crest armor: bracing taunts attackers per hit taken.
status_effects.tick_formula: No direct damage. 30s duration: AI targets focus the taunter; target deals 50% less damage. Battle Junk: taunted targets take 50% increased weakpoint damage from all sources.
status_effects.trigger: Added Y1S3. 'Provoking' weapons (e.g. Phoenix Talons) build Taunt charges per shot; Battle Junk 'Provoke' applies Taunt charges on weapon hits within 200m.

status_effects.confidence_note: Effect text is verbatim official Y3S2 patch notes, but it is tied to a specific Y3S2 reward/mod (context: 'Primary/Secondary' lines), not a universal rule for all fire builds.
status_effects.name: Charred
status_effects.stacking: Spreads within 150m if the charred target is also Ablaze. Linked secondary effect: 10% of Burning damage dealt to an Ablaze target is also dealt to other enemy ships within 150m.
status_effects.tick_formula: No direct DoT. While Charred: target takes 30% more Burning damage and receives +15% Torn Sails status charge. Charred targets that are also Ablaze build Charred on other targets within 150m.
status_effects.trigger: Y3S2 content (appears to be a Mythic mod / specific reward effect): dealing at least 2000 Burning damage in a SINGLE hit applies Charred for 30s.

status_effects.name: Piercing
status_effects.stacking: Additive portion of each hit; no status instance.
status_effects.tick_formula: Piercing portion penetrates hull armor and deals bonus damage to weak points (Piercing I +50%, II +75%, III +100% damage to weakpoints).
status_effects.trigger: Not a charge status — a damage type. Weapon perks add X% of damage as Piercing (e.g. Piercing I: +10%, Piercing II: +20%, Piercing III: +30%).

status_effects.name: Severe Damage
status_effects.stacking: Accumulates as a pool; restored by the effects above.
status_effects.tick_formula: Reduces effective max hull until restored. Repair kits do NOT restore it. Restored by: Ouroboros armor perk 'Restoration' (100/s), Barque/Cutter perks (0.4%/s), repair-weapon procs (10% on use), Ouroboros 'Amalgamate' (15% of damage braced healed while bracing).
status_effects.trigger: Caused by flooding damage (and some affixes/enemies). A separate unrepairable-by-kit damage pool on the hull.

status_effects.name: Toxic / Poison
status_effects.tick_formula: DoT details not published. The Toxic perk on La Piqure drains target crew stamina (7 per hit after Y2S1.1 nerf from 15) — its PvP function is denying the enemy's ability to brace. Outbreak effect (Galleon): weak-point hits have a chance to trigger Poison; consecutive weak-point hits increase the chance.
status_effects.trigger: Poison weapons (La Piqure long guns, Rotmouth/Spirit Caller cannons, Plaguebringer builds).

status_effects.name: Electrified
status_effects.tick_formula: Unknown — may be the pre-activation charge state of Stormstruck or a distinct effect. No official definition found.
status_effects.trigger: Mentioned in Y1S3-era Heaven's Mandate perk: 'If a target is afflicted with the Electrified status effect, hits have a 15% chance to summon a devastating Lightning strike that deals 1500 Electric Damage.'

status_interactions.effect: Charred targets take +30% Burning damage (multiplicative with other bonuses; official Y3S2 text).
After triggering Stormstruck on a target, damage from the NEXT attack is increased by 50%.
status_interactions.interaction: Stormstruck -> next-attack damage (Charge Stores furniture, official Y1S3)

status_interactions.effect: +10% Ablaze charge rate on targets already affected by Stormstruck.
status_interactions.interaction: Stormstruck -> Ablaze charge (Charge Stores, official Y1S3)

status_interactions.effect: Triggering Ablaze on a target increases Shell-shocked charge rate by 100% for 10s.
status_interactions.interaction: Ablaze -> Shell-shocked charge (Mark of the Wolf furniture, official Y2S1)

status_interactions.effect: Explosive hits have 70% chance to trigger a bonus explosion (125m radius); 100% if the target is already Ablaze.
Hitting a target with Ablaze applies Torn Sails.

Ember: weapon hits apply 1 stack (max 20, 5s, decays one by one); each stack -2% target Armor Rating and -2% Fire Resistance. At max Ember, hits build Inferno (max 10 stacks, 5s): each stack -0.5% reload time and +3% weapon damage. Allies (XSML/SML/MED) within 500m get half the Inferno bonus. At max Inferno, next hit triggers a fiery explosion for 200% of weapon damage as Fire damage (20s cooldown).
status_interactions.interaction: Ember/Inferno stacks (Junk ship perks, official Y3S2)

status_interactions.effect: User observes ~+200% electric damage from furniture (names he gave: 'Relentless Force' + 'Impetus Order'). NOTE: In Y3S2 'Relentless Force' is the name of a seasonal MASTERY perk (Impetus stacks), not furniture found in web sources. Web sources confirm these electric furniture pieces instead: Charge Stores +5% electric weapon damage (official Y1S3); Leyden ('Laten') Vault Array +2% electric damage per 5m of weapon AoE radius, -6% electric reload, +8% damage vs Stormstruck targets (community build guides); Copper Fashioning Station +12% electric secondary damage, +8% max range (community). The user's '+200% electric' and the specific furniture names could not be verified online — validate in-game.

User describes Stormstruck application chance stacking +2% per hit up to 40%, resetting after 10s without hitting. No web source found confirming this exact mechanic — likely a specific weapon/furniture perk on his loadout. Validate in-game.

Shell-shocked and Torn Sails only: first activation grants 45% charge resistance for 45s; re-activation adds a second 45% stack multiplicatively = 1-(0.55*0.55) = ~70% total resistance, resetting the 45s timer; one stack removed per 45s without activation.
status_interactions.interaction: Diminishing returns on re-applied statuses (official Y2S1.1)

status_interactions.effect: While under Ablaze/Flooded/Stormstruck, ramming an enemy spreads the status to the target; +30% duration of those statuses on self; -10% incoming damage from those statuses on self.
status_interactions.interaction: Status spread on ram (Freeman's Embrace furniture, official Y1S3)

weak_points.confidence_note: Existence of weak-point bonus confirmed by many sources; exact base multiplier estimated from community reports (~2x).
weak_points.description: Ships have red-marked weak points (parts like mortar towers on forts). Hits on weak points deal bonus damage. Evidence: WCCFTECH 'aim for the red... bonus damage'; Frigate dev blog: its extra weak points 'take 30% more damage in PvP'; Battle Junk 'Provoke': taunted targets take +50% weakpoint damage from all sources; weapon perks: Piercing I/II/III give +50%/+75%/+100% damage to weakpoints; Divine Thunder +75%; community reports ~2x ('double dmg for weakpoints', Steam). Y3S2 mastery: 'Weakness Finder' 20% chance to convert shots to weakpoint hits (5s); 'Firepower Order' converts ALL weapon hits to weakpoint hits for 8s after spending 10 Impetus stacks via auxiliary fire.
weak_points.formula: weakpoint_hit_damage = normal_hit_damage * (1 + weakpoint_bonus), where weakpoint_bonus includes a base component (community-estimated ~1.0, i.e. ~2x total) plus perk bonuses (+50%/+75%/+100% etc.). Base component is NOT officially published.

notes: CONFIDENCE SUMMARY. Confirmed (official patch notes or multiple agreeing sources): status effect roster and most durations/tick values (Stormstruck 15s/1000-per-3s/arcs, Shell-shocked 3.3s/3000 AoE, Taunt 30s/50% less damage, Torn Sails 75% slow, Charred 30s/+30% burning, Severe Damage unrepairable-by-kit, diminishing returns 45%/70%/45s on Shell-shocked + Torn Sails), charge-based status application, ascension system structure (Basic/Advanced/Special slots by rarity; Mythic Ascension/Reforge in Y3S1; Adept/Mythic mods + mod transfer in Y3S2), mastery/Impetus system (90 points, Relentless Force/Weakness Finder/Firepower Order), demi-cannon 100m/120m falloff bands, brace as stamina+brace-strength block with named synergies, weak-point bonus existence, armor rating + per-type resistances itemization, and all listed official furniture/armor/ship perk texts. Likely (one good source, consistent): two-step damage formula (armor then per-type resistance), ~2x base weak-point multiplier, no-drop-off Siege Mortar, multiplicative furniture stacking per community build guides, standard DPS formula structure, no stamina->damage link. Estimated (inferred or user-observed, needs in-game validation): exact armor-rating-to-damage function, exact base brace mitigation %, exact Ablaze/Flooded tick damage and durations, 'secondary damage' stat definition and its multiplicative stacking, reload-reduction stacking rule, intrinsic per-weapon falloff curves, Toxic/Poison and Electrified details, and the user's specific numbers (+200% electric from 'Relentless Force'/'Impetus Order' furniture — note Y3S2 uses 'Relentless Force' as a mastery perk name, so verify his item names in-game; Stormstruck chance +2%/hit to 40% resetting after 10s; +5% rocket dmg per 20% hull missing; +20% secondary up close -2%/50m; +10% rocket secondary; dynamic ballast -30% cap at 600m+; Infernal Maw Basic +71/shot, Advanced +33.1% burning, Mythic +7% electric; 28 mastery points). BIGGEST GAPS for the calculator: (1) the numeric armor-mitigation function — without it, absolute damage vs armored targets cannot be computed, only relative comparisons; recommend the app fit this empirically from his gameplay tests; (2) base brace % and Ablaze/Flooded tick formulas — same empirical-fit recommendation; (3) additive vs multiplicative confirmation for furniture pools — build the engine with a per-pool stacking-mode flag so it can be flipped after his tests. Fandom wiki (skullandbones.fandom.com) item pages corroborate perk wordings but lack formulas. No official damage-formula whitepaper exists; treat all community formulas as reverse-engineered.
